summary.prose: The build adds the one shared wording of the path rule and puts it in the schema descriptions, then in every synthesize prompt and the step prompts that author paths, and only then adds the write-time check that refuses a call site or a code or doc citation that is not in that form. The order keeps the check from refusing stages that have not yet been told the rule. Existing records are not touched.

tasks.title: Add PATH_FORM_RULE and describe the path-valued schema fields with it
tasks.summary: Add the PATH_FORM_RULE string constant to src/workflow/runners/scope-prompts.ts, stating the form (project file relative to the root, optional :N, :N-M or :N:C and #anchor, no prose in the span, never shortened; external file written in full; a path copied from a step output that is not in this form is corrected rather than copied). Add a description carrying that wording to the callSites and pathsCited fields in the design-story, define, design-epic and plan schemas, without adding a pattern.
acceptanceChecks: PATH_FORM_RULE is exported from src/workflow/runners/scope-prompts.ts and nowhere else defines the wording
The callSites field in the design-story schema and the pathsCited field in the design-story, define, design-epic and plan schemas have a description that carries the rule wording
No schema gains a pattern or a new required field, and the existing schema tests still pass

tasks.title: Add the path check and the 'paths' failure kind
tasks.summary: Add the 'paths' kind to ValidationFailure in src/workflow/synthesizer.ts and add checkPathForms(citations, callSites), which checks the ref of code and doc citations and an LLD's call sites by their strings only (accepting the line forms and #anchor, absolute paths and http(s) URLs, refusing prose, whitespace, a leading ./ and .. segments, and naming every offending entry). Call it from validateBodyAndCitations after the boundary and citation checks, reading dataModelChanges[].callSites from the body when present. Added last, after the prompts carry the rule. Leave the daemon correction loop in src/daemon/workflow-rpc.ts and the in-session phase in src/daemon/steps/workflow-step/phases/synthesize.ts unchanged and confirm they handle the new kind.
acceptanceChecks: checkPathForms accepts a relative path with :N, :N-M, :N:C and #anchor, an absolute path and an http(s) URL, and refuses prose, whitespace, a leading ./ and a .. segment, naming each offending entry
Only citations of kind code and doc are checked, and an artifact with no dataModelChanges reads no call sites
validateBodyAndCitations returns the existing boundary and citation results unchanged for a well-formed artifact and a 'paths' failure otherwise
The daemon correction loop still tests only 'boundary', and the in-session phase returns a retryable synthesize-paths error with the entries in its message
